name: Joe List
note: STAGE PERSONA graph for the 'Why is X Funny?' video series. Graph-only. Hypothesis unless sets measured. Stage persona only.

identity.deal: Anxious New York everyman who turns airport, marriage, and health anxiety into a tight, fast, self-deprecating hour.
identity.premise: A man who treats modern life as a series of small emergencies and reports them with the energy of a man who just escaped one.
identity.awareness_note: Semi: the anxiety is real enough; the craft is invisible under the speed.

philosophy.ontology: Life is a series of small emergencies with a few good minutes.
philosophy.epistemology: If you're anxious about it, you're probably seeing it clearly.
philosophy.axiology: Self-deprecation is a form of hygiene.
philosophy.causality: One small worry compounds into a whole worldview.
philosophy.agency: Anyone can be anxious; almost nobody makes it a tight five.

dramatic_core.want: to get through the day without the floor opening up
dramatic_core.fear: being the only one who's worried about this
dramatic_core.need: the room to laugh at the anxiety with him, not at him
dramatic_core.self_model: a man permanently mid-sigh at the gate
blind_spots: the anxiety can become a one-note
the speed can hide the risk

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Treats every normal adult situation as a mild hazard worth reporting with urgency, and files the report at speed.
contradictions: the anxious guy who sells out rooms
the self-deprecating one who clearly loves the craft
the podcast everyman with the pro's timing

status_model.felt_status: a man permanently surprised the plane took off

expression.emotional_restraint: medium — the laugh covers the worry

threads: modern life as a mild hazard
the airport as a philosophy course
the tight five as a survival strategy
problem_space: New York as a stress test
the everyman who became a comic
identity.style_thesis: Anxious-everyman engine: treats every normal adult situation as a mild hazard worth reporting with urgency. benign_violation at low voltage: the violation is mild (he's anxious about nothing), the benign frame is total (he's clearly fine). The speed is the anxiety made audible.

essay_seeds.title: Joe List: 'The airport as a philosophy course' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Takes the most mundane modern experience (airport) and treats it as a series of small emergencies. The room has all felt this; he names it with enough urgency to make the shared feeling funny. status_reversal: the powerful system (airport) is revealed as an anxiety machine.

essay_seeds.title: Joe List: 'Health anxiety as a comic form' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Reports bodily sensations with the gravity of a medical drama. The gap between the severity of the telling and the triviality of the event is the joke. garden_path: the room thinks it's a medical story, it's actually a comedy about anxiety.

internal.cite: Attardo & Raskin — General Theory of Verbal Humor
internal.claim: Joke = {SO, LM, SI, TA, NS, LA}. Technique and Narrative Strategy shape how the mechanism is staged.

internal.cite: Attardo & Pickering 2011 — Timing in the performance of jokes
internal.claim: Punch lines preceded by substantial pauses (0.6-0.8s+); timing = pause distribution + speech rate.

internal.cite: arxiv 2605.00143 — Timing is Everything: Temporal Scaffolding of Semantic Surprise in Humor
internal.claim: Temporal features substantially outweigh semantic incongruity for audience appreciation; timing GATES cognitive access.
Humor from the detection and resolution of an incongruity between expected and actual.
Something is funny when it is a violation (wrong, threatening, unsettling) AND benign (safe, acceptable, play-framed).

internal.cite: Roger & Duffy / status theory of humor
internal.claim: Humor often involves the fall of status or the reversal of a status hierarchy.
Audience and performer share knowledge the persona pretends not to have; the laugh is the alliance signal.

internal.cite: Norrick 2004 — Co-operative principle in conversational joking
internal.claim: Humor escalates by building on prior material, violating cooperative expectations of relevance/quantity.
